ns2:section.sectionText: This course uses economics tools to understand and evaluate public policy issues surrounding energy markets and the environmental markets to which they are closely tied. Will focus on the economic drivers of energy production and use, transportation and storage of energy commodities, regulation of energy markets, and policies designed to mitigate the impact of energy production and consumption on the environment. Prerequisite: ECON 302.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to students with Graduate class standing.
